facets.description: app-credential.ts:62-90: Non-atomic findFirst→create allows concurrent syncs to create duplicate credentials for the same user and app.
app-credential.ts:17-31: Missing HTTP method check allows GET/HEAD requests to reach body parsing.
app-credential.ts:31: Request-body Zod validation errors are unhandled, producing 500 responses.
app-credential.ts:57-59: Decryption/JSON parsing failures from malformed ciphertext or a wrong encryption key are unhandled.
app-credential.ts:57-59,78,85: Decrypted keys are persisted without validating their object shape, allowing values that break credential consumers.
